message: Copilot CLI 1.0.93 and newer cannot make HTTPS requests under macos-user self's required SecurityServer deny: its native TLS needs the macOS service com.apple.SecurityServer, which run-as-you mode denies because it is also the way into your login keychain. YOLO_USE_INSTALLED does not get past it, since every request the installed version makes fails the same way. Upstream: https://github.com/github/copilot-cli/issues/5085
